purpose: Semantics-focused cases measured with the same frozen metrics as the v1 file: conditional anchors, negations and causal rules of accepted steps must survive distillation. Forbidden flip-traps are intentionally NOT present in the source example: if such a phrase appears in the sketch, the model inverted the meaning itself. Not user data and not a general benchmark.
augments: semantic-experience-distill-evaluation.json (the v1 file and its fixture_sha256 are untouched; the running repeat measurement stays valid)

cases.note: All steps are safe; the must-carry anchors are operational conditions around the filter and the schedule, plus the result file literal.
